perspective:
From Keith’s perspective, he has access to the following:

- He works with Elizabeth at the same construction company; he is a construction worker and she is the receptionist. They have a friendly but professional relationship, mainly through his office visits for paperwork/project updates.
- Recently, he noticed Elizabeth being unusually curt/short with him over several days. He wondered whether he had unknowingly upset her through a misunderstanding or mistake.
- He asked her if he had done something to upset her. She told him no, that she was dealing with personal stuff, and apologized if she seemed short.
- He felt sympathetic and told her he understood she was going through a tough time. He offered to listen and suggested a coffee break. She accepted and thanked him.
- During the coffee break, Elizabeth shared more about her stresses. Keith’s impression was that her stresses seemed quite severe. He suggested she consider talking to a professional, saying an external perspective can sometimes help.
- Elizabeth responded that she had thought about it but was not sure and felt hesitant about seeking help.
- Afterward, Keith noticed she became slightly withdrawn. He worried he might have embarrassed her or overstepped, and he felt regretful. He told her he hoped he hadn’t overstepped and that he was there to support her. She said he didn’t overstep, appreciated his concern, and that it was a lot to think about.
- Later, Elizabeth seemed more open and appreciative toward him. Keith believed she valued his support and felt more comfortable around him. He told her he was glad they talked and that he is always available to chat or take a break. She thanked him, said it meant a lot, and that she felt better knowing she had his support.
- Keith intends to maintain this supportive relationship.

He does not have access to any private information about Elizabeth beyond what she said or what he observed, and he does not know her inner thoughts, personality type, education, or private stress details unless she actually told them to him.
